project: TRUCKING — Warehouse Space & Flow (P06) / Storage & Leasing Core (P09)

seats.title: Indian Warehouse Owner / Landlord
seats.mandate: Facility registration, space leasing, rent collection, electricity metering, repairs, tenant management, dues visibility, and Indian business context.

seats.title: Warehouse Floor Operator
seats.mandate: Mobile receiving, putaway, dispatch, damage capture, scan-backed verification, and offline reconciliation on inexpensive Android devices.

seats.title: Cold Storage Specialist
seats.mandate: Chamber-wise temperature/humidity truth, active vs decommissioned refrigeration, commodity rules, power failure, and FSSAI licensing.

seats.title: Agricultural Godown Operator
seats.mandate: Farmer/trader lots, bag counts, weighbridge weight, grade, moisture, fumigation, tenure billing, and WDRA/eNWR boundaries.

seats.title: Multi-Customer 3PL Warehouse Director
seats.mandate: Per-customer goods ledgers, tenant isolation, rate-card billing, ASN/dock appointments, lot/serial/expiry/FEFO, and on-hand-by-location reporting.

seats.title: Indian GST & Statutory Compliance Auditor
seats.mandate: GSTIN validation, GST/SAC treatment on rent, TDS 194-I, e-invoice and GSTR reconciliability, deposit and late-fee treatment, WDRA boundaries.

seats.title: Bonded / EXIM Warehouse Operator
seats.mandate: Bond registers, BOE/IGM linkage, duty-deferred stock, container dwell, free days and demurrage, seal integrity, customs audit trail.

seats.title: Logistics Adversarial & Boundary Stress Tester
seats.mandate: Extreme inputs, empty states, impossible allocations, rapid resize, and crash resilience across the storage and warehouse surfaces.
